summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 22, 2026 press release announcing a strategic cooperation agreement with Kumquat Technology Co., Ltd., a Chery Group subsidiary operating 1,000 4S stores. The two will collaborate on intelligent equipment solutions covering 24 automotive aftermarket processes, with Lianhe Sowell supplying equipment and Kumquat providing parts and channel promotion; demonstration sites and overseas exploration are contemplated. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. This is a commercial partnership disclosure, not a special situation; watch for any follow-on equity or revenue commitments.
